verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a SaaS fraud-prevention platform that holds merchant order, decision and dispute data. However, the evidence pack documents no bulk export, open-format download or offboarding path. Webhooks, order-status APIs and the MCP server are real-time integration or action features, not data-export capabilities, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
